content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 because required prior authorization was missing, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. Resubmission or additional records alone would not cure the authorization denial, while a formal appeal is permitted and similar Silverbridge claims succeeded with necessity appeals in 2 of 3 cases. The strong documentation and valid diagnosis pairing support appealing within the remaining timely-filing period.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
